decisions.statement: A path the world names no page at is refused.
The value carried is named by its place or by a field that value states.
The place it goes to is named by a place or by the value already holding it.
A call naming the value both ways is refused rather than read one way.
A call naming the place it goes to neither way is refused.
`onto` is read under the field `where` names, so a call saying it says both.
A place that is no whole number is refused before the page is read.
Carrying the value is left to the mechanical change of the same name.
That change is reached through the runner rather than by an import.
Nothing here works out a body of its own.

definition: one value carried into place in the list a page property holds, judged by the checks a landing runs
